title: MongoDB Company Values Launch Campaign
summary: A company values launch campaign for MongoDB, developed through storyboarding, original illustration, presentation design, and communications design.
overview: A storyboarded presentation campaign introducing MongoDB's company values, developed through original illustration, presentation design, and communications design. The work follows a cast of illustrated characters through narrative scenes — building, exploring, and reflecting — each paired with a specific value, from "Build Together" to "Be Intellectually Honest" to "Own What You Do."
